card.name: Split-off start of bradycardia
card.fires_on: Mostly the split piece "BR" or "br" that begins the word bradycardia ("br" + "adycardia"), after hypotension or sinus. It also fires weakly on a few other words in cardiovascular and bone-health sentences.

modes.label: Other mid-phrase words
modes.description: Occasional single words in a medical phrase, such as the D in vitamin D or LDL before apheresis.
